title: 才 vs 就 Step 5 · 一…就… and 才 = Only Just
description: 一…就… = as soon as. And 才 on its own = only just, a moment ago: 我才知道 (I've only just found out).

points.title: 一…就… = as soon as
points.summary: One action follows the other immediately.
points.body:
- 他**一**到家**就**睡了。 He fell asleep as soon as he got home.
- 我**一**喝咖啡**就**睡不着。 Whenever I drink coffee, I can't sleep.

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: He fell asleep as soon as he got home.

points.title: 才 = only just (a moment ago)
points.summary: 才 + verb with no time word before it: it happened only just now — often surprised.
points.body:
- 我**才**知道。 I've only just found out.
- 他**才**走。 He's only just left.
- Similar: 刚 / 刚才 (just now).

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: You're married? I've only just found out!

questions.translation: He went to eat as soon as class was over.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kāfēi}{就|jiù}{睡|shuì}{不|bu}{着|zháo}。」 mean?
options: I can't sleep, so I drink coffee.
I drank coffee and then slept well.
Whenever I drink coffee, I can't sleep.
notes: The order is the other way round.
questions.translation: Whenever I drink coffee I can't sleep.

questions.prompt:
A：{他|tā}{还|hái}{在|zài}{吗|ma}？
B：{他|tā}（　）{走|zǒu}，{你|nǐ}{快|kuài}{去|qù}{追|zhuī}！
notes: 就走 = leaves right away / soon.
questions.translation: A: Is he still here? B: He's only just left — run after him!

questions.prompt: 'As soon as she saw me, she smiled.' Which sentence says so?
notes: 一 pairs with 就; 才 doesn't take 了.
questions.translation: As soon as she saw me she smiled.

options: First: he's only just arrived. Second: he didn't come until ten.
questions.explanation: No time word → only just; time word + 才 → not until.
notes: With a time word, 才 = not until.
Without a time word, 才 = only just.

questions.prompt: Build it: 'As soon as he gets home, he plays games.'
questions.explanation: 他**一**回家**就**玩游戏。 一 + first action, 就 + what follows at once.
questions.translation: As soon as he gets home, he plays games.

questions.prompt: Which word can replace 才 in 「{我|wǒ}{才|cái}{到|dào}。」 (I've only just arrived)?
notes: 就到 = will arrive right away.

questions.explanation: 一 pairs with **就** — and 才 doesn't take 了.
questions.translation: He fell asleep as soon as he got home.
You've moved? How come I'm only hearing about it now?
